text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとジタンは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Zidane are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとジタンは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Zidane are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
おのれの運命は、ひとりで背負うべきものと
責任感ゆえに、自分を追い込んでしまう。
text.official_en: You feel it is your responsibility to confront your own destiny—a philosophy that puts immense pressure on yourself.
text.real_en: You believe that you must bear your fate alone, and your sense of responsibility drives you into a corner.

text.jp:
けれどジタンには、自分が存在する理由より
大切なものがあったのです。
text.official_en: In the end, however, Zidane did not succumb to it; he instead found a path <text style="italic">he</> wished to walk.
text.real_en: But to Zidane, there was something more important than the reason he existed.

text.jp:
こうして冒険に乗り出したジタンは
いつも前向きに仲間を支えましたが……
text.official_en: Zidane was a ray of positivity at the outset, but something would happen to snuff out that cheerful light.
text.real_en: And so Zidane set out on his adventure, always supporting his companions with his optimism, but...

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp: それは、魔性の霧がただよう異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this world, much of the land was shrouded in an eldritch mist.
text.real_en: A memory of another world, where an eerie mist hangs in the air...

text.jp:
ただしジタンの場合は、ひと目で王女に
惹かれていたからでもあったようです。
text.official_en: That, however, was not the only reason he accepted Garnet’s request; he was also enthralled by her beauty.
text.real_en: In Zidane’s case, though, it seems he was also drawn to the princess at first sight.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
のちに彼らが晴れの舞台で再会したとき
宝珠よりも輝いたのは、喜びの涙でした。
text.official_en: When they were reunited, however, during an enthralling stage production, the tears of joy that fell were more precious than any crystal.
text.real_en: When they later reunited onstage, their tears of joy shone brighter than any jewel.

text.jp: ひとりで決着をつける
text.official_en: Settle the score alone.

text.jp:
ふたつの星が重なる異界の幻影　ジタン
テラに生まれガイアに生きて命をつなぐ。
text.official_en:
Living Link Zidane
A man who was born on Terra, became a thief on Gaia, and saved people from both worlds.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision from a world where two planets overlap: Zidane. Born on Terra, he lives on Gaia and carries life forward.

text.jp:
まだ生きている者を放ってはおけない。
あなたの選択は、ジタンと同じです。
text.official_en: Your decision is the same as Zidane’s; neither of you could bear the thought of leaving someone behind.
text.real_en: You could not leave someone who was still alive behind. You made the same choice as Zidane.

text.jp:
ジタンの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Zidane’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ジタンは、戦い慣れない王女や黒魔道士の
ビビを励まし、勇気を引き出しました。
text.official_en: During their adventure, Zidane offered encouragement to Garnet and the black mage Vivi, which proved invaluable to their personal growth.
text.real_en: Zidane encouraged the inexperienced princess and the black mage Vivi, helping them find their courage.

text.jp:
ジタンも警告しましたが、王女はひるまず、
覚悟のあかしに、ダガーと名乗りました。
text.official_en: And so Zidane did the same for Garnet, who, to prove her resolve, assumed the alias of “Dagger.”

text.jp: 与えられた運命に従う
text.official_en: Follow the path that was laid out for you.

text.jp:
世界をゆるがす脅威を追ううち、自分が
この世界の人間ではないことを知ります。
text.official_en: In the process of saving their world, he came to learn a most unnerving truth: he was not originally from that world at all.
text.real_en: While pursuing a threat that shook the world, he discovered he was not a human born of that world.

text.jp:
世間知らずの王女から
冒険の案内を頼まれたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were a princess to ask to accompany you on your adventure, despite knowing little of the outside world, what would you do?
text.real_en: If a princess who knew little of the world asked you to guide her on an adventure, what would you do?

text.jp: 仲間たちと言葉を交わす
text.official_en: Exchange words with your companions before leaving.
text.real_en: Speak with your companions.

text.jp:
仲間だからこそ、ジタンの想いを理解して
止めずに送り出し、帰りを祈ったのです。
text.official_en: Ultimately, rather than try to accompany or restrain him, they saw Zidane off and prayed for his safe return.
text.real_en: Precisely because they were his friends, they understood, saw him off without stopping him, and prayed for his return.

text.jp: 仲間の声を聞く
text.official_en: Listen to what others have to say.

text.jp:
冒険に危険はつきもの。甘い考えでは命を
落とすと、伝えないのは無責任ですね。
text.official_en: Adventures are fraught with danger, and a true leader would be remiss not to inform their companions of this harsh reality.
text.real_en: Adventure comes with danger. It would be irresponsible not to warn her that a naive outlook could cost her life.

text.jp:
危険な選択でも、仲間だからわかってくれる。
クジャを見捨てないジタンを、誰も止めません。
text.official_en: In spite of the inherent danger, your allies would not stop you, for they know you well—as Zidane’s companions did him.
text.real_en: Even if the choice was dangerous, Zidane trusted his friends to understand. None of them stopped him from saving Kuja.

text.jp:
危険を冒して宿敵を助けに戻るか、
仲間たちと脱出するか――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you faced with either rescuing your worst enemy from dire straits, or escaping with your dear companions—what would you do?

text.jp:
帰るべきところに彼を連れ戻したのは
必死に呼びかけた、仲間たちの声でした。
text.official_en: Finally listening when his friends reached out to him, however, kept him from crossing the point of no return.
text.real_en: It was the desperate voices of his companions that brought him back to where he belonged.

text.jp:
彼がクジャに告げた言葉は……
「誰かを助けるのに理由がいるかい？」
text.official_en: As Zidane asked Kuja upon coming to his rescue: “Wouldn’t you do the same for me if you knew I was dying?”
text.real_en: He said to Kuja... “Do you need a reason to help someone?”

text.jp:
彼の名は、ジタン……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That thief’s name is Zidane, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Zidane... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
彼もそう思いつめていましたが、仲間は
ジタンをひとりにはしなかったのです。
text.official_en: Zidane also believed he should carry that burden himself, but his companions were adamant they share the load.
text.real_en: Zidane was just as troubled, but his friends would not leave him alone.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp:
戦いが終わり崩壊がせまる中、ジタンは
気づきます……クジャがまだ生きていると。
text.official_en: Yet even after their final battle and with global cataclysm imminent, Zidane realized: Kuja still lived.
text.real_en: The battle was over and collapse was near when Zidane realized... Kuja was still alive.

text.jp: 戦えるよう励ます
text.official_en: Instill in her the confidence to fight.
text.real_en: Encourage her to learn to fight.

text.jp:
救出をめざすジタンも、見送る仲間たちも
別れの涙とは無縁でした。
text.official_en: Neither Zidane, who aimed to come back alive, nor his fellow party members who let him go shed a tear when he left.

text.jp: 旅の危険を伝える
text.official_en: Apprise her of the risks.

text.jp: 本気なら引き受ける
text.official_en: Oblige her, as long as she was serious.

text.jp: 涙を流して別れを告げる
text.official_en: Say a teary goodbye.

text.jp:
無茶でも本気の頼みなら、ひと肌ぬぐ。
義賊と呼ぶにふさわしい振る舞いですね。
text.official_en: For you, the sincerity of a request trumps the difficulty of it—an attitude befitting a kind-hearted bandit like Zidane.
text.real_en: Even if the request is unreasonable, you would help if it was sincere. A fitting deed for someone worthy of being called a noble thief.

text.jp:
王女ガーネットの誕生日を祝って
にぎわう、アレクサンドリアの都。
text.official_en: The capital of Alexandria was astir, as birthday celebrations for Princess Garnet were underway.

text.jp:
盗賊の彼は、劇団を装って忍び込んだ城で
王女に出会い、あることを頼まれます。
text.official_en: While masquerading as a member of a theater troupe, a thief managed to meet the princess, who asked of him a favor.

text.jp:
相手を守るだけではなく、戦う力が身に
つくように励ますことも思いやりです。
text.official_en: Were someone to venture out into the world, they should be able to hold their own; as any traveler can attest.
text.real_en: Caring for someone means not only protecting them, but also encouraging them to learn how to fight.

text.jp:
真実を知って動揺したジタンは敵の術中に
落ち、自分を見失ってしまいます。
text.official_en: Upon discovering the truth, Zidane lost sight of who he was, and thus played directly into the hands of his foe.

text.jp:
自分が、この世界を乱すために
つくられた生命だと知ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to learn that you were created—not born—on another planet, for the purpose of plunging your homeworld into chaos, what would you do?
text.real_en: If you learned you had been created to bring turmoil to this world, what would you do?

text.jp:
自分が存在する意味を知り、そのために
生きるという選択は責められません。
text.official_en: The allure of following a predetermined path—even if it means casting your agency aside—is strong.
text.real_en: There is no blame in learning why you exist and choosing to live for that purpose.

text.jp:
誰もが傷つき迷いながらも懸命に生きて、
彼らは、破滅を願うクジャを倒します。
text.official_en: After suffering myriad injuries and hardships, the party finally defeated he who sought the world’s destruction—Kuja.
text.real_en: Though they were all hurt and lost their way at times, they fought hard to live, and together defeated Kuja, who sought destruction.

text.jp: 迷わず助けに向かう
text.official_en: Rescue your enemy without hesitation.
